topography.project_purpose: Yield Aggregator. Structurally: 42 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 7 ERC4626 vaults, 10 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 2 functional families. Its contracts share 13 common project-authored base contract(s) (baseadapter, accesscontrolenumerable, erc165). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
